acceptanceCriteria: The OpenCode plugin and Core agree on one file-change path bound: the plugin splits batches at Core's bound, or caps at it, or Core abstains on an over-bound batch with a closed degradation code.
Any abstention is surfaced at info level and stays non-blocking (AHI-044); no coded-less refusal reaches the plugin.
A real-binary JS test sends an OpenCode file-change of 101 to 256 paths and observes no warning-level corvint-command-failed.
AHI-022 and the impact path-bound traceability rows are updated to name the agreed bound and the test.
body:
Reported 2026-10-05 by the peer session "Claude-mem repository analysis" while working V1-0767. Core built from fecce039, version 1.0.0-rc.1.

The OpenCode plugin (integrations/opencode/src/index.js, queueFileChange) batches up to MAX_TRACKED_PATHS=256 paths into one `harness event --event file-change`. Core refuses any batch over 100 paths with `{"error":"impact paths exceed 100-path bound","ok":false}`, which carries no `code`, so the plugin raises the visible warning `corvint-command-failed` (event file-change) instead of an info-level degradation.

Reproduction: `echo '{"paths":[...256 "dir/fN.go"...]}' | corvint --root R harness event --host opencode --host-version unknown --surface plugin --adapter-version 0 --event file-change --input - --budget-bytes 8000`.

Expected: plugin and Core share one bound; an over-bound batch is split or abstains with a closed code at info level. Actual: a coded-less refusal and a terminal warning for any patch touching more than 100 files.

Related but distinct: V1-0450 (file-change refuses untracked paths) and V1-0746 (adapters drop unrecognised events without a code, completed).

completion.reason: PR beamfall/corvint#589 merged into main as a62e1917e0087722f439fb448ba12a12ce7627df (2026-10-05T03:49:16Z). AC1 met: the OpenCode plugin caps each file-change batch at MAX_FILE_CHANGE_PATHS = 100, which is Core's maxImpactPaths bound (splitting and a coded Core abstention were rejected with reasons). AC2 met: a capped batch is named at info level as changed-paths-truncated, ledgered as an adapter code, and stays non-blocking. AC3 met: a real-binary test sends a 150-path patch and observes no non-timeout warning and no file-change corvint-command-failed; the negative control with the cap at 256 fails it. AC4 met: AHI-022 text and its traceability row name the bound, the constant and the test. The OpenCode adapter went to 0.7.8. Codex review findings fixed with a clean re-review; dogfood check and seal PASS (14 of 14 hunks). Limits: paths beyond 100 in one batch get no impact evidence (disclosed by the truncation row); the JS constant duplicates the Go constant; live OpenCode qualification NOT_OBSERVED; make gate NOT_RUN. Evidence: sha256 at a62e1917 of the build log, the AHI spec, the adapter tests and the plugin source. Completed by the orchestrator at the request of the authoring session.

title: OpenCode file-change batches over 100 paths fail as corvint-command-failed against Core's 100-path impact bound
